name: The Final Message to the Wildhammer
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
<Otho hands you a long, blood drenched spear, wrapped in several gryphon feathers.>

You take this, mon. You take this to Aerie Peak, dead center of town by the well. You plant it! Drive it right into the ground! Show those dwarves that troll mean business! Come back when you do this. Hopefully you come back alive.
narrative.objectives:
Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to travel to Aerie Peak in the western region of the Hinterlands and place the Final Message to the Wildhammer by the well in the center of town. Return to him once this task is complete.

Beware of angry Wildhammer dwarves and unruly members of the Alliance.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I wish I coulda been there to see the look on their faces, mon. Are they packing up their bags? Leavin' town?

You done good, adventurer. Real good. Otho reward you with the big mojo.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 48 to 50, 15,750 XP in all.

quests.name: Message to the Wildhammer
quests.objectiveText: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to slaughter 15 Highvale Outrunners, 15 Highvale Scouts, 15 Highvale Marksman and 15 Highvale Rangers.

quests.name: Another Message to the Wildhammer
quests.objectiveText: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to bring him 10 Long Elegant Feathers from the gryphons that inhabit the Hinterlands.
